// Compiled explicitly by the native regression; no secret data is requested.
#include <Security/Security.h>
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
 if (argc != 3 || strlen(argv[2]) != 64 || strspn(argv[2], "0123456789abcdef") != 64) return 2;
 SecKeychainRef keychain = NULL;
 OSStatus status = SecKeychainCopyDefault(&keychain);
 if (status != errSecSuccess) { fprintf(stderr,"default keychain OSStatus %d\n",(int)status); return 1; }
 CFMutableDictionaryRef q = CFDictionaryCreateMutable(NULL,0,&kCFTypeDictionaryKeyCallBacks,&kCFTypeDictionaryValueCallBacks);
 CFStringRef account = CFStringCreateWithCString(NULL,argv[2],kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
 const void *values[] = {keychain};
 CFArrayRef search = CFArrayCreate(NULL,values,1,&kCFTypeArrayCallBacks);
 CFDictionarySetValue(q,kSecClass,kSecClassGenericPassword);
 CFDictionarySetValue(q,kSecAttrService,CFSTR("com.data-mate.vault"));
 CFDictionarySetValue(q,kSecAttrAccount,account);
 CFDictionarySetValue(q,kSecMatchSearchList,search);
 CFRelease(account);CFRelease(search);CFRelease(keychain);
 if (!strcmp(argv[1],"delete")) {
  // Opt-in exact fixture cleanup may show native OS authorization UI.
  CFDictionarySetValue(q,kSecReturnRef,kCFBooleanTrue);
  CFTypeRef item=NULL;status=SecItemCopyMatching(q,&item);
  if(status==errSecSuccess && item) {status=SecKeychainItemDelete((SecKeychainItemRef)item);CFRelease(item);}
  if (status == errSecItemNotFound) status=errSecSuccess;
  CFRelease(q);printf("exact deletion OSStatus %d\n",(int)status);
  return status == errSecSuccess ? 0 : 1;
 }
 if (strcmp(argv[1],"count")) {CFRelease(q);return 2;}
 SecKeychainSetUserInteractionAllowed(false);
 CFDictionarySetValue(q,kSecReturnAttributes,kCFBooleanTrue);
 CFDictionarySetValue(q,kSecMatchLimit,kSecMatchLimitAll);
 CFTypeRef result=NULL;status=SecItemCopyMatching(q,&result);CFRelease(q);
 if (status==errSecItemNotFound) {puts("0");return 0;}
 if (status!=errSecSuccess || !result || CFGetTypeID(result)!=CFArrayGetTypeID()) {fprintf(stderr,"count OSStatus %d\n",(int)status);if(result)CFRelease(result);return 1;}
 printf("%ld\n",(long)CFArrayGetCount(result));CFRelease(result);return 0;
}
